'''Chiaki Takahashi''' (Japanese: '''たかはし智秋''' ''Takahashi Chiaki'') is a Japanese voice actress for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

== Biography ==
Takahashi was born on May 8, 1977 in {{wp|Kanagawa}}, {{wp|Japan}}. Takahashi started her work in {{aniseries|PTS}} during the beginning of {{aniseries|BW}}. Her most notable role is that of the [[Officer Jenny]]s of [[Unova]]. To date, she has not had any further roles after the end of the ''Black & White'' series.
